name: std01
requirement: Use the pinned KerML 1.0 and SysML 2.0 definitions for every supported language construct; identify relevant clauses, metaclasses, library dependencies, and tests.
acceptance: Inspect the coverage manifest and independently validate the self-model with the pinned libraries.

name: std02
requirement: Publish separate support status for parsing, representation, validation, interchange, and execution. Reject unsupported semantics with a diagnostic; do not silently approximate them.
acceptance: Load a valid but unsupported parallel-state model: retain the source, report the limitation, and refuse execution.

name: self01
requirement: Maintain Agentique architecture, requirements, a runnable behaviour slice, and verification definitions in version-controlled SysML, linked to implementation modules and tests.
acceptance: CI checks that every requirement has a model declaration, test reference, and responsible implementation module.

name: mod01
requirement: Assign stable model-element identities and preserve references through supported rename, move, edit, and persistence operations. Runtime occurrence identity shall remain separate.
acceptance: Rename and move a referenced part; reload the project and verify that the reference denotes the same model element.

name: mod02
requirement: Apply model edits as atomic change sets against an explicit base revision. Preserve invalid drafts separately from the last accepted revision.
acceptance: Submit conflicting edits from the Conversation and Surface; only one commits, and the other receives a conflict without partial changes.

name: mod03
requirement: Read and write the selected standard textual and project-interchange representations for the supported subset, preserving meaning and explicit identity mappings.
acceptance: Round-trip the self-model and a separate fixture through .sysml and .kpar; compare resolved structure and retained identity metadata.

name: sim01
requirement: Prepare execution only after reference resolution, required validation, complete scenario binding, and supported-semantics checks have succeeded.
acceptance: A missing input value, unresolved type, or unsupported reachable operation blocks preparation with element-specific diagnostics.

name: sim02
requirement: Create isolated run state from immutable model and scenario revisions. A run shall not mutate the authored model or another run.
acceptance: Prepare two scenarios from one revision; step one, then verify the other state and model digest are unchanged.

name: sim03
requirement: Support initialise, run, pause, step, stop, reset-as-new-run, and inspection under the AGQ-SEQ-01 execution contract.
acceptance: Compare manual stepping and continuous execution for identical inputs; semantic transitions and final state agree.

name: sim04
requirement: Reproduce the semantic trace for identical model, libraries, scenario, engine build, and execution-contract versions. Exclude wall-clock and generated identifiers from trace comparison.
acceptance: Execute the positive fixture twice; compare normalized trace digests and final states.

name: sim05
requirement: Distinguish a completed experiment from a passed check, and distinguish waiting, exhausted inputs, ambiguity, limits, interruption, and evaluation errors.
acceptance: The rejection scenario completes with a rejected model state; a no-input scenario ends input_exhausted, not passed.

name: sim06
requirement: Record each input delivery and semantic step with its model reference, run identity, ordering, before/after state references, and evaluation outcome.
acceptance: Select a recorded transition in the Surface and navigate to its exact source element and model revision.

name: ui01
requirement: Use one accepted model revision and explicit run context across the Conversation and Surface. All semantic writes shall use the same Engine operation boundary.
acceptance: Inspect a selection through both interfaces, approve an edit, and verify both display the new revision and identify older runs as pinned.

name: ui02
requirement: Provide a Canvas of model-backed Views for structure, properties, behaviour, and run history. Keep layout independent of model semantics; provide keyboard and non-diagram alternatives.
acceptance: Rearrange a View without altering the model digest; complete the model-and-run inspection using keyboard navigation and a table/tree view.

name: ai01
requirement: Expose typed, scoped tools to one Assistant. Present proposed semantic changes and scenario changes for Human Operator approval before commit or execution.
acceptance: Reject an unapproved or stale proposal; accept an approved proposal only for the reviewed base revision and payload.

name: sec01
requirement: Run simulations without network, shell, build, deployment, or live-agent effects. Treat imported models and Assistant output as untrusted inputs.
acceptance: Attempt an external call from a simulated action; execution is refused and no external side effect occurs.

name: nfr01
requirement: Persist accepted revisions and acknowledged run checkpoints durably. On restart, preserve the last committed checkpoint and mark an unfinished active run interrupted.
acceptance: Terminate the process between checkpoints; recover committed data without a false completion or replaying external effects.

name: nfr02
requirement: Enforce declared input, memory, trace, and step limits and expose progress/cancellation. Use bounded background work for parsing and execution.
acceptance: On the declared benchmark host, stop or pause is acknowledged within one second at a safe point; reaching any limit has an explicit outcome.

name: ext01
requirement: Keep the Rust modelling and simulation libraries independent of HTTP, storage, UI, and AI-provider implementations. Isolate adapters behind typed contracts.
acceptance: Run semantic and simulation tests in-process without a database, browser, network, or AI provider.

name: trace01
requirement: Link Agentique model requirements and components to implementation revisions and verification evidence. A trace link alone shall not constitute satisfaction.
acceptance: Follow a requirement to its SysML declaration, responsible Rust module, test definition, and recorded result with revision identifiers.
